description: Dept. of Government Information -  Guidelines  for the issuing of official media accreditation cards for the year 2020
reasoning: This gazette content outlines guidelines for issuing official media accreditation cards for journalists and media personnel. It falls under Public Service Gazettes as it deals with administrative procedures, eligibility criteria, and application processes for public service-related accreditation (media professionals working with government information). The content focuses on service conditions, recruitment procedures, and administrative instructions for media professionals rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or other specialized categories.
